compilation.scope: Our contribution: the frozen station list, the row selection, the derived binary label, the temporal and station-disjoint partitions, the feature construction and the packaging. Does not cover or relicense NOAA's data.

source.status: Public Domain (US Government work), preserved unchanged

Same page: "NOS requests that attribution be given whenever NOS material is reproduced and re-disseminated. Pursuant to 17 U.S.C. 403 ... stating that such material is not subject to copyright protection." CONSTRAINT READ ON THE SAME PAGE, honoured in the release: "This information shall not be modified in content and then presented as official government material" - any derived dataset must be labelled as derived and must not be presented as official NOS data. Corroborating: nauticalcharts.noaa.gov/data/data-licensing.html records NOAA data released under a CC0-1.0 public-domain dedication (CC BY 4.0 for some products), and the NCEI ISO metadata for CO-OPS stations carries the same CC0 waiver. source.citation: NOAA CO-OPS. Verified daily maximum water level observations (product daily_max_min) and minor flood thresholds (station metadata API) for 122 NOS stations, 2006-2025. Retrieved 2026-09-18 from https://api.tidesandcurrents.noaa.gov/. Public Domain. Derived dataset: NOAA tide flooding prediction dataset, version 2026.09.
